title: sherardia maritima
intro: Sherardia maritima, commonly known as "Sea Lavender" or " Irish Lavender", is a perennial plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sherardia maritima include pain relief, wound healing, and the reduction of stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
